items.text:

items.title: Mixing chains-- KMC + SRAM for tandem timing chain?
items.text:
Mixing chains-- KMC + SRAM for tandem timing chain?
I've got a brand new 10sp SRAM chain (PC 1051) that I cut a couple links too short for anything useful (oops), but.....  It's time to replace the timing chain on our tandem, which takes a little less than 2 chains.    I could use the short one in combo with another, but the other I have on hand is a shiny new KMC 10.93.  It doesn't have to shift or anything, so my thinking is that it should be OK, but I thought I'd check in with more knowledgeable folks.

Any thoughts on the wisdom of mixing brands?
